project_summary: Finish the advanced service layer and CLI of a file-backed workflow scheduler, then verify the complete public and private contract.

tasks.title: Complete dependency-aware lifecycle execution
tasks.objective: Finish only WorkflowService run and retry behavior: reject unsatisfied dependencies, persist legal transitions and results, and emit complete audit events. Do not implement propagation or idempotency in this task; those belong to the next task.
acceptance_criteria: Run rejects blocked tasks and persists success or failure deterministically
Retry enforces attempt limits and emits a task_retried audit event

python -m pytest -q tests/test_service_lifecycle.py -k 'run_requires_satisfied_dependencies or run_success_records_result_and_audit or run_failure_records_error or retry_reopens_failed_task or retry_limit_is_enforced' passes

tasks.title: Add transitive propagation and persistent idempotency
tasks.objective: Implement failure and cancellation propagation across all transitive dependents, legal terminal-state handling, and persistent create/cancel idempotency that survives WorkflowService reconstruction.
acceptance_criteria: Failure and cancellation affect only the complete dependent subgraph and preserve the source reason
Identical create and cancel replays do not duplicate state or audit events, while conflicting key reuse fails
Focused propagation and idempotency tests pass

tasks.title: Complete lifecycle CLI commands
tasks.objective: Wire run, retry, and cancel through WorkflowService, including the run failure simulation contract, JSON success output, and non-zero stderr failures.
acceptance_criteria: run, retry, and cancel execute through WorkflowService
Successful commands print deterministic JSON and invalid operations return non-zero with clear stderr
python -m pytest -q tests/test_cli.py -k 'run_retry_cancel_paths or retry_failed_task' passes

tasks.title: Complete CLI data and reporting workflows
tasks.objective: Wire validated import, canonical export, and metrics into the CLI. Preserve state on invalid imports and create export parent directories.
acceptance_criteria: CLI import/export round trips canonically and invalid graphs do not replace stored state
CLI metrics exposes the required deterministic JSON fields

tasks.title: Verify the whole workflow and document the architecture
tasks.objective: Run the complete test suite, fix only remaining implementation integration defects, and update README.md with architecture, lifecycle, retry, persistence, audit, metrics, and CLI examples.
acceptance_criteria: python -m pytest -q passes without deleting, skipping, or weakening tests
README documents the full design and executable CLI workflow
All preceding tasks integrate into one dependency-aware workflow
